summary: TechNature is a Dutch maker of camera-based sorting machines and crop sensors, with machines for potatoes and onions and a sensor for field crops. It is based in Moerkapelle, Zuid-Holland. Wouter Bac started it as a sole proprietorship in 2014. Its PotatoCam sorts 16 tonnes of seed potatoes per hour, as stated.
machines: PotatoCam: optical sorter that grades potatoes by defects such as scab, rot and growth cracks, and by size
PotatoCam NIR module: optional add-on to detect internal defects
PreCam: pre-sorting camera that detects clumps before the next step; onions, potatoes, shallots
SpectraCam: field crop sensor on a sprayer or tractor measuring chlorophyll, biomass and stress
facts: PotatoCam capacity: 16 tonnes of seed potatoes per hour
PotatoCam: three output streams as standard, optional fourth; up to 16 views of each potato
Staff: 13 permanent employees and 10 on-call workers
Focus moved from consultancy to product development in 2018

contact.address: TechNature B.V., Moerkapelse Zijde 36, 2751 DL Moerkapelle, Netherlands

limitations: Ownership, prices, camera specifications and after-sales terms are not published on the pages read.
